what: The PUBLISHED 0.17.4 force supervisor interrupted four team members of this wave at ~900 s, with 'Last tool calls: (none recorded)', requeued their rows, cleared their owners and emitted 21 ownerless [split] rows.
whyItMatters: This is the same defect PR #101 repairs (merged to dev, NOT released). The session runs the INSTALLED @mpd-dsh/mpd@0.17.4, so the repair is not in effect and the defect reproduced inside this wave's own team.

observed.evidenceThatTheMembersWereWorking: senior-engineer-6 had written packages/mpd-tui-plugin/src/panel-core.ts (+109/-17) and created packages/mpd-tui-plugin/test/panel-scroll.test.ts before the interrupt, yet the handoff recorded 'Last tool calls: (none recorded)'.
observed.recovery: watchdog.forceAfterMs set to 0 in .mpd/mpd.jsonc; session-watchdog-status reports forceAfterMs=0 and 'the file layer is applied LIVE (T-18)'. The 21 split rows were closed (T12 as failed, the rest completed) and the four parent rows reassigned and re-dispatched.

bounds: Single session, this workspace, 2026-11-06. Not a claim about the fixed dev tree, which was not running here.
